purpose: Teach: 大木/所沢/野原/大輔/中西/大津/大平/大江

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、林間学校で大木に登ってたな
lines.en: Riku—you were climbing that huge tree at forest camp, weren't you.
lines.style: Casual accusatory tone. Light, teasing. Drops the question mark energy on the statement. Like catching him in something harmless and enjoying it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、家族で所沢の航空公園行ったろ、桜
lines.en: What about you? Your family went to Tokorozawa Air Park, didn't they, Sakura.
lines.style: Turns it back on her, quick and even. Soft challenge underneath—not aggressive, just matching her game. Eyes steady.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、漫画「クレヨンしんちゃん」の野原家好きだったな
lines.en: Riku—you liked the Nohara family from Crayon Shin-chan, didn't you.
lines.style: Pulls back. Slightly more genuine underneath the wry. Less teasing, more observation. Like she's remembering something he wouldn't expect her to remember.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、サッカー部の大輔先輩を尊敬してたな、桜
lines.en: You looked up to your soccer club's Daisuke senpai, didn't you, Sakura.
lines.style: Matches her shift. Quieter now. Not teasing—just returning what she gave. The point is that he was paying attention too.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、塾の中西先生厳しかったな
lines.en: Riku—your cram school teacher Nakanishi was pretty tough, wasn't he.
lines.style: Back to wry. Lighter again. Testing whether he'll keep meeting her at this depth or if they're trading volleys. Small smile underneath.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、家族で滋賀県大津に行ったろ、桜
lines.en: Your family took a trip to Otsu in Shiga, didn't they, Sakura.
lines.style: Keeps the same light rhythm. Not rising to the bait. Just continuing the pattern. Steady, predictable, safe.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、社会で大平正芳総理の名前覚えたな
lines.en: Riku—you memorized Prime Minister Ohira's name in social studies, didn't you.
lines.style: Surprised shift. Genuine curiosity this time, not teasing. Like she's caught him doing something she wouldn't have guessed. Small laugh underneath.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、国語で大江健三郎の小説扱ったろ、桜
lines.en: You read Kenzaburo Oe in Japanese class, didn't you, Sakura.
lines.style: Mirrors her genuine curiosity. Softer attack. Like they've both stopped the game for a second and are just wondering about each other. Close and interested.
